Store Fleet HPD Trend — Right-Sizing Impact Over Time
Actual store fleet avg HPD (measured) Implied HPD if no right-sizing (workload / larger fleet) Cumulative lift preserved
Story: Fleet HPD held roughly steady from April (3.304) to June (3.292) despite fleet reduction — but without right-sizing, the same total workload spread across the pre-disposal fleet would have driven per-unit HPD down to 3.102. Right-sizing has preserved ▲0.190 HPD of utilization through 23 cumulative disposals.

Company Owned Operating Lease (exit at any time)
Acquisition strategy: All new assets are company-owned cash purchases. Operating leases can be exited at any time — no distinction in savings calculations.
Operational view (oldest-first): Same trigger as the 60% view — a store qualifies for a removal when it has at least one flagged unit. The difference is the target: instead of pulling the lowest-utilized unit, this view pulls the oldest unit at the store (respecting min fleet). The flagged unit picks up the freed workload, raising its utilization. Identifies 29 units across 24 stores with $386,538/yr in P&L savings.
